parameter.name: organizationPartyId
parameter.description: Optional stock/planning owner. Only documents with this verified owner contribute.

parameter.name: estThruDate
parameter.description: Limits order item by requiredByDate, run consume/produce by estimatedStartDate, production estimate by readyDate. Allows requiredByDate and estimatedStartDate to be null (missing).

parameter.name: infoByProductId
parameter.description:
A Map where the key is a productId and the value is a Map with: orderQuantitySum, quantityReservedSum, quantityNotAvailableSum, quantityNotIssuedSum, orderNotReserved, prodEstQuantitySum, availableToPromiseTotalSum, quantityOnHandTotalSum, estimatedConsumeQuantitySum, consumeQuantitySum, estimatedProduceQuantitySum, produceQuantitySum, estRunConsumeRemaining, estRunProduceRemaining, and totalProjected.
The totalProjected value = availableToPromiseTotalSum - orderNotReserved - estRunConsumeRemaining + estRunProduceRemaining + prodEstQuantitySum

parameter.name: infoByProductId
parameter.description: A Map where the key is a productId and the value is a Map with: orderQuantitySum, unitAmountMin, unitAmountMax, weightedAmountSum, and weightedAmountAvg.

service.description: An organization's inventory valued at each asset's cost on a day (AssetValuationSummary's current cost, back to the cost before each later revaluation or landed cost) through that day, by product beside the posted balance of its inventory accounts, with the totals of stock, the inventory and WIP accounts and their difference; the movements that explain a difference (receipts and issues that posted nothing, zero-cost receipts, count variances that did not post, stock postings in the error journal) and the open WIP of each run. Refuses a user without Accounting report read in the organization, a facility of another organization and a future day.

An organization's stock movements of a fiscal period or a date range: receipts, issues and count variances of its inventory, each with its facility, product, asset, lot and source, quantity, cost, value and posting result, with the totals of each kind. A kind with more than listLimit movements is reported incomplete. Refuses a user without Accounting report read in the organization, a period of another organization and a facility of another organization.

parameter.name: movementKind
parameter.description: receipt, issue or variance; all when empty

service.description: A product as Accounting sees it in an organization: its stock quantity and value beside its inventory balance, its approved standard costs and book events (revaluations, landed costs, cost repairs), its recent movements, its current prices when the user holds PRICE_VIEW, and its GL mappings (ProductGlAccount, and ProductCategoryGlAccount of its categories) for the organization and those it rolls up to. A product the organization neither owns nor holds is productFound false. Refuses a user without Accounting report read in the organization.

The valuation rows of the period close checklist (CloseServices.define#CloseCheck): the period's receipts without a cost basis (no acquire cost, or posted at zero), and for each organization of the close the difference between its stock value and its inventory accounts at the period's end. Refuses a user who may not read the organization's periods.
